definitions.explanation: Money paid for the use of borrowed money, or earned on deposited money.

examples.japanese: {銀行|ぎんこう}に{預|あず}けると{利息|りそく}がつく。
examples.english: If you deposit at a bank, you earn interest.

examples.japanese: {利息|りそく}が{高|たか}いローンは{避|さ}けたい。
examples.english: I want to avoid loans with high interest.

examples.japanese: {毎月|まいつき}の{利息|りそく}を{支払|しはら}う。

notes:
{利息|りそく} refers to interest on money.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {利息|りそく}がつく: to earn interest
- {利息|りそく}を{払|はら}う: to pay interest
- {利息|りそく}が{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い: high/low interest

RELATED TERMS:
- {金利|きんり}: interest rate
- {利子|りし}: interest (same meaning, slightly more formal)
